article.story: Oakland Golden Grizzlies (0-3) at Alabama Crimson Tide (2-0) Tuscaloosa, Alabama; Monday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Oakland enters the matchup with No. 20 Alabama after losing three games in a row. Alabama finished 12-3 at home last season while going 25-10 overall. The Crimson Tide averaged 91.2 points per game while shooting 45.5% from the field and 35.8% from 3-point range last season. Oakland went 16-16 overall with an 8-9 record on the road last season. The Golden Grizzlies allowed opponents to score 81.7 points per game and shot 47.2% from the field last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
